defect.description: Status.Code, Status.Message, and Status.Proto dereference the receiver or its inner status without nil checks, so a Status with a nil inner proto — which FromProto(nil) returns — panics in s.s dereference as soon as any accessor is called, as does any accessor on a nil *Status.
defect.provenance: fix PR #1211 (commit 84cd50a): nil guards added to all three accessors
